description: Read a case's first-reading debate track, including speech text and source links. Filter by person or party and page through entries. Chairing remarks are excluded by default.

include_chair.description: Include chairing speeches, which are omitted by default.

limit.description: Maximum number of debate entries to return.

offset.description: Offset into the filtered debate entries.

party_id.description: Only speeches by this party ID, using party membership on the meeting date when needed.

person_id.description: Only speeches by this resolved person ID.

name: get_case_debate
